observations.classification: Selected source guard confirmed, no new finding count.
observations.trace: ArmorDetail::segments uses divisors 1/12/16/24 and caps at source, so zero source produces zero even with positive minimum. The selected boundary sampler uses steps.max(1). rounded_slot has source=4, minimum=1 and therefore nonzero corner_steps for each closed detail variant. Visor interior uses segments(20,3), between 3 and 20, so 20/segments is positive. These are source and mathematical arguments, not executed sampling.
observations.limits: A positive step does not prove finite, nondegenerate or simple input geometry; zero semantics elsewhere and full producer/native inventory remain open. 774 ADDITIONAL-063 and 059 READ-L11-427 separately record these guards.
